simple.meaning: שְׁבוּת (shᵉbûwth) is a Hebrew action word meaning “exile , concretely, prisoners ; figuratively, a former state of prosperity.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 41 times in Deuteronomy, Job, Psalms, Jeremiah, Lamentations, and 5 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 30:3. The surrounding contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁבוּת (H7622) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שְׁבוּת (shᵉbûwth) / H7622 is traced through Deuteronomy 30:3, Job 42:10, Psalms 14:7, Psalms 53:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.
